reason: The smooth-gluing inference is incorrect as written: a nonzero bump function does not vanish on a neighbourhood of the boundary of its own support (points on that boundary are, by definition, in the support). The relevant patch boundary is dB_s, and the proof must instead state/use supp(chi) compactly contained in B_s, hence chi vanishes on a neighbourhood of dB_s, so the coordinate formula agrees smoothly with the constant map there. Also, the asserted estimate ||chi(y)Ay||<R does not follow from the listed properties of chi unless the cutoff is explicitly chosen with |chi|<=1 (or s is chosen using sup|chi|). Thus the stated inference to a well-defined smooth global G has an actual missing/false premise.
